standard_prerequisites.name: Setup: a simplicial topological space and an abelian sheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: X a simplicial topological space, F an abelian sheaf on X_{Zar}; the spectral sequence is claimed with E_1^{p,q} = H^q(X_p, F_p), functorial in F.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Z-resolution on the simplicial site
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, \label{lemma-simplicial-resolution-Z} and Cohomology on Sites, Lemma \label{sites-cohomology-lemma-injective-abelian-sheaf-injective-presheaf}
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 634-641: A^{p,q} = Gamma(X_p, I_p^q) = Mor_PAb(Z_{X_p}, I^q); the rows of the double complex are exact in positive degrees and evaluate to Gamma(X_{Zar}, I^q) in degree 0.

standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of restriction and injectivity of the restricted sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 641-648: restriction is exact, so F_p -> I_p^bullet is a resolution; the I_p^q are injective abelian sheaves on X_p.

standard_prerequisites.name: The homological-algebra machinery
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 648-651: the first-quadrant spectral sequence lemma and the double-complex resolution lemma conclude.

core_obligations: The double complex (proof lines 632-634): A^{p,q} = I^q(X_p) with first differential the alternating sum along the d_i^{p+1}-maps I_p^q -> I_{p+1}^q given by the description of sheaves on the simplicial site.

The rows (lines 634-641): A^{p,q} = Gamma(X_p, I_p^q) = Mor_PSh(h_{X_p}, I^q) = Mor_PAb(Z_{X_p}, I^q); hence by the Z-resolution lemma and the injective-presheaf lemma the rows are exact in positive degrees and evaluate to Gamma(X_{Zar}, I^q) in degree 0.

The columns and conclusion (lines 641-651): restriction is exact, so F_p -> I_p^bullet is a resolution; the I_p^q are injective on X_p; the cohomology of the columns computes the groups H^q(X_p, F_p); the first-quadrant spectral sequence lemma and the double-complex resolution lemma yield the spectral sequence with E_1^{p,q} = H^q(X_p, F_p) converging to H^{p+q}(X_{Zar}, F).
proof_roadmap: Build the double complex of sectionwise injective values with the alternating-sum first differential.
Identify the rows via the Z-resolution on the simplicial site and injective presheaves.
Identify the column cohomology with the component cohomology groups and conclude with the first-quadrant lemma.

H2: double-complex bookkeeping, topological twin of card L46178.
